dedupe_keys.name: power plant siting results for godeeep

description: Pacific Northwest National Laboratory publishes CERF power-plant siting results for eleven western US states under two GODEEEP scenarios. Zenodo provides four CSV tables and documentation free under CC BY 4.0. Business-as-usual and net-zero pathways include Inflation Reduction Act incentives, carbon capture, SSP2 assumptions and RCP8.5 climate effects over 2020–2050. One-kilometre tables describe additions; plant-level tables combine existing facilities and clustered new sites. Attributes include technology, capacity, location, retirement, costs and generation. These outputs can inform grid-expansion and infrastructure-land-use simulations. Related G6 model-cerf-capacity-expansion-regional-feasibility generates the siting; catalogue data-gcam-usa-godeeep-scenarios describes underlying pathways. Solar and wind cell coordinates are capacity allocations, not individual facilities. Coordinates use ESRI:102003. Limitations from scenario assumptions and spatial aggregation affect interpretation as forecasts. No tables were downloaded or siting feasibility independently checked.
